content.query:
--#1
SELECT TOP 50 CustomerID FROM dw.AGGREGATE_TOTAL_CUSTOMER_HOLDINGS_FACT
WHERE Deposits_Outstanding_Balance > 0
AND Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance > 0
AND CustomerID LIKE 'C%'
 
--#2
SELECT TOP 50 CustomerID FROM dw.AGGREGATE_TOTAL_CUSTOMER_HOLDINGS_FACT
WHERE CustomerID LIKE 'C%' 
AND Deposits_Outstanding_Balance > 0
OR Deposits_Year_To_Date_Average_Daily_Balance > 0
